name: ASPSMS
description: ASPSMS is a powerful SMS gateway service that enables businesses to send and receive SMS messages globally. It offers a reliable platform for communication, marketing, and notifications, making it ideal for enhancing customer engagement.

events.d: Send a text message to one or more recipients.
Generate one or more voucher codes to transfer SMS credits to another user or keep for later.
Redeem an ASPSMS voucher code to add SMS credits to your account.
